entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: Demon, one of four who dealt with Liliana Vess after the Mending; gave her eternal youth as tattoos.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker bound to Kothophed, who killed him with the power of the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact retrieved from the Onakke Catacombs that freed Liliana of Kothophed.

entities.name: Onakke Catacombs
entities.description: Place on Shandalar where the Chain Veil was.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event after which the demons dealt with Liliana.

events.summary: Kothophed sends Liliana to retrieve the Chain Veil from the Onakke Catacombs.
events.quote: she was sent to retrieve the Chain Veil from the Onakke Catacombs on Shandalar

events.summary: Liliana takes the Chain Veil and throws off Kothophed's yoke.
events.quote: she was granted enough power to throw off the yoke he had placed upon her

events.summary: Liliana kills the dying Kothophed with the power of the Veil.
events.quote: Liliana finished the demon with the power of the Veil

relations.quote: Liliana finished the demon with the power of the Veil
as part of her servitude towards him
